name: io.github.ebeirne/lians
title: Lians Memory for AI Agents
description: Local-first memory for any AI agent. Remember and recall across sessions through MCP.

environmentVariables.name: LIANS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional base URL of a hosted or self-hosted Lians server; omit for local SQLite mode

environmentVariables.name: LIANS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key with read and write scopes

environmentVariables.name: LIANS_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Agent identifier used as the memory namespace

environmentVariables.name: LIANS_LOCAL_DB
environmentVariables.description: Local SQLite path used when LIANS_URL is omitted
